tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gtor ma bzhugs//

"$ ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la pyag 'tshal lo// gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang*/ khro bcu dang*/ zad par dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ gza' dang*/ klu dang*/ 'byung po rnams kyi rim pa ni/ ci 'byor pa gang yang rung ba'i snod du bshams nas/ shwa lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga dang dkar gsum dang mngar gsum la sogs pa dang mchod pas brgyan pa la/ byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdag nyid dpal rdo rje'i skur bsgoms pas/ bgegs dang 'byung po la sogs pa la gtor ma sbyin cing*/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams su bya ste/ thams cad la rim pa 'dis so// mngon rtogs ltar kha lag dag par byas nas/ gtor ma sbyang ba ni/ oṃ oṃ badzra tsan tra sarba dha rma shu bi shud dha swa bha bā sarba dha rma bha sho tra yā swa hā/ oṃ āḥbadzra pu rdza sarba dharma pra bho dha ka yā sarba dharma pra bho dha yā swa hā/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra a nā la sarba dha rma pra ti ba ga sarba dha rma pra ti pa ya swa hā/ oṃ sarba dha rma badzra a mri ta ka rā sarba dha rma na badzra a mri ta ku ru ku ru swa hā/ sngags kyi tshig 'di rnams kyis lag pa g.yon pas go rims bzhin sbyang bar bya'o// de nas thal mo bkab la/ yam̐ las rlung nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa/ kam̐ las thod pa'i sgyed po gsum/ a las ka pa la chen por bsams te/ nang du gho ku dha ha na las/ ba glang dang khyi dang rta dang*/ glang po che dang mi'i shwa'i rang bzhin/ bhi mu ra shu las/ bzhi mnyam gla rtsi/ tsan dan/ si la ga pur gyi rang bzhin du bsams nas/ oṃ gyis sbyangs/ a yis spel/ hūm̐ gis sbyar/ ho yis bdud rtsir byas nas/ de la mchod pa dang 'dod pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phro bar dmigs la/ dkyil 'khor rnams la gtor na na so so'i sngags dang phyag rgyas 'bul bar bya zhing*/ na ma dang bcas pa'i mchod pa ltar bya ba yin no// gnas skabs khro bo la sogs pa rnams la ni khro bo rnams rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya ni lag pa thal mo sbyar la mthe bong mthe chung nang du bkug gung mo sbyar la rwa dbus ma byas/

'dzum mo srin lag rdo rje'i ra ltar byas pa ste/ phyag rgya 'di ni phyag rgya bzang po zhes bshad pas las thams cad byed do// de bzhin du zad par rnams gri gug gi phyag rgya gug ste/ khu tshur la mthe'u chung bskyang pa'o// lha rnams ral gri'i phyag rgyas dgug ste/ lag pas g.yas kyi mthe'u srin lag mthe bos mnan nas/ gung mo dang 'dzub mo gshibs te brkyang pa'o// gza' rnams la rin po che'i phyag ni gung mo gnyis nang du bkug cing mthe bong dang sprad la gzhan rtse sprad cing brkyang pa'o/ klu rnams la pad ma'i phyag rgya ni/ lag pa g.yon pas mthe chung mthe bo mnyam du byas la/ gzhan gsum po so sor phye ba ni pad ma'o// 'byung po yi dwags rnams ni 'khor lo'i phyag rgya ste/ lag pa gnyis kha sbyar la sor mo rnams brkyang ba'o// khyi'i phyag rgya ni grong gi 'byung po dgu ste/ de nas khro bo rnams la sngags 'dis gtor ma 'bul lo// oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ ushni sha/ sum̐ bha ni sum̐ bha/ bigga nan tā kā/ ni la dān dha/ pra dzña ta ka/ ḍa ki ra tsa/ pad mān ta kā/ ā tsa la ya man ta kā/ ma ha pa lā bhya/ sa pa ri bha ri bhyaḥ i dhaṃ bha li/ ghan dham̐/ pu pa/ dhu pam̐/ di paṃ a kṣa tam̐/ da dha ma hi/ te tsa a kad dha yā/ sa pa ri bā ra shri ghram̐/ i dham̐ bha ling ghri nna tu kha dan du/ pi pa de dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ san hri pa ta/ sarba swa ta nam̐/ shan tyam̐/ pus tiṃ/ rakṣa bha ran/ gur bha ti ku bhan tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra dha ra ā dzā pa ya ti swa hā/ zhes mchod pa'i khyad par dang bdud rtsir bsams la 'phro ba'i sbyor bas tshim par bya'o// zad par la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho a kas bha yu te dza yu ta ka pi thir bi pa ti te bhya/ sa pa ri bha ra man chad 'dra bas gtor ma btang bar bya'o// de nas phyogs skyong la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥbra hma bhi shū/ shi rī te/ bha yu/ yā mā/ agne/ sa mu tri/ i shā ra/ in tra/ ya kṣe bhya/

sa pa ri bha ra man chad 'dra bas gtor ma sbyin no// de nas gza' rnams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ ra hū ka la ag ne/ tsan tra/ surya/ bhu dhya/ mam̐ gha la/ shu tra/ bhri ha pa ti/ ke tu sha nā bhyaḥ sa pa ri bha ra man chad 'thun pas gtor ma sbyin no/ de nas klu rnams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho dzā yā/ bhi dza yā/ pad ma kar ko tra/ bha su kī shi pa lā/ ku li kā/ a nan tā/ ta kṣa kā/ ma ha pad me bhya/ sa pa ri bha ra gong bzhin du gtor ma sbyin no// de nas 'byung po rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ be ta ṭa bī kri te/ mu khā sha ka/ kha shu gar/ ghrid ta/ bhya ghra/ u lu ka/ dzām̐ bu ka/ ghā ru ṭā/ mu khwe bhyaḥ sa pa ri bha ra man chad mthun pas gtor ma byin la/ bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol te/ bsdu ba'i tshe/ khro bo rnams gsang bar ham̐ la bsdu ba'o// spyi gtsug am̐ las zad par rnams so// dpral bar i la phyogs skyong ngo*// mgrin par ri la gza' rnams so// snying khar u la klu rnams so// lte bar lī la 'byung po rnams bsdu'o// bgegs kyi gtor ma sbyang ba'i sngags dang*/ gzhi bdag gi gtor ma sbyang ba'i sngags ni dbang chog gi de nyid yin no// yang bye brag tu mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha la ni/ sngar ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la 'gron spyan drang ba'i tshe/ sangs rgyas yab dang yum dag bcas// sras bcas 'khor dang grogs dang bcas// gnyen ni ma lus pas bskor ba// lha dang lha mo dag gi tshogs// rnams kyi dge bar mdzad bzhin pa// rdo rje sems dpa' 'dir spyon cig ces brjod nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams ni/ oṃ ha hā hi hī badzra bha re bā/ a kar sha yā/ pra be sha yā pra be sha yā/ bhan dha yā bhan dha yā/ to sha yā to sha yā/ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ badzra dha ki ni hri dha yam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phreṃ phreṃ phaṭa zhes bkug nas mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/
badzra dha ki ni sarba bhya ya sa pa ri wa ri bhya man chad thams cad 'dra/ de nas bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol te// smon lam gdab bo// gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so/// /
